messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY INCIDENT -> oncall amy: Canary health checks failing for model service 'text-gen' (canary group c-7). Metric: token-decoding-errors = 12.3% over 5m (threshold 1%). Triggered 2412345678

amy: acked. paging SRE + ML. Going to triage.

jordan: saw the alert, on it. Canary rollout finished ~7m ago by ml-deploy-bot. Initial hypothesis: tokenizer mapping mismatch between weightbundle v2026-03 and tokenizer v2026-02.

kevin: curious — are these 5xx or decoding errors? logs?

jordan: mostly ValueError: unknown token id 50256 at decode step. sample stack:```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/inference/serve.py", line 412, in decode_batch
    outputs = tokenizer.decode(ids)
ValueError: Unknown token id 50256
```

amy: that looks like token ID mapping changed. ml-deploy-bot: can you give the deployed artifact hashes for canary hosts?

ml-deploy-bot: Deploy report: rollout id r-2412, model-weight-bundle: sha256:ab3f...c9, tokenizer-artifact: sha256:e1f2...a8 (tokenizer version tag: token-v2026-02).

jordan: weights bundle was built against tokenizer token-v2026-03 (internal build metadata points to tokenizer hash e1f2...b0). So mismatch confirmed — weights expect new vocabulary but canary served old tokenizer.

kevin: oof. That explains decoding errors. Are we seeing customer-facing errors or internal only?

dave-cs: CS report: 3 customers filed API errors for malformed completions in last 10m. Traffic impacted ~1.1% of requests (canary percentage). No major data exfiltration. Customers flagged incorrect tokens appearing in outputs.

amy: mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop canary routing to new weight bundle, 2) rollback weight rollout to previous release on canary hosts, 3) block further auto-rollouts until postmortem. Who can flip the flag now?

kevin: I can flip flag. Command:```
# feature flag CLI
redwood flags set model_v2026_03_rollout false --env=prod --scope=canary --by=kevin
```
I'll run that and confirm traffic shift.

ops-bot: ACTION: Taking canary routing out of the new weightset; adjusting routing policy to prefer model_v2026_02 replicas.

kevin: done. Feature flag set -> false. Confirming routing change. Request samples show traffic now hitting model_v2026_02.

amy: next: rollback weight bundle on canary hosts to release-20260210. jordan, can you run the rollback job?

jordan: initiating rollback job. Command:```
ml-deploy rollback --service=text-gen --target=canary --to-tag=release-20260210 --wait
```
Starting now. Will stream status.

ml-deploy-bot: Rollback job started (job id jb-8243). Rolling back 12 canary instances.

jordan: 6/12 instances rolled back, 11/12 now using release-20260210, last one failing due to transient disk mount error — restarting agent.

ops-bot: restarted agent on host canary-07, mount reattached.

jordan: rollback completed. All canary instances now running release-20260210 and tokenizer token-v2026-02.

amy: monitoring metrics. token-decoding-errors dropping... now 0.2% over 5m. Good.

dave-cs: CS: will reply to impacted customers with a mitigation note and timeline. No escalations yet.

kevin: we should also temporarily disable automatic canary rollouts until we confirm fix to packaging pipeline. I'll set kill-switch:```
redwood feature-flags set auto_canary_rollouts false --env=prod --by=kevin --note="temp disable after token mismatch"
```

kevin: kill-switch set. Confirmed.

jordan: preliminary root cause: packaging job for weights omitted tokenizer-version pin (packaging config drift). The weight artifact declared tokenizer tag token-v2026-03 in metadata, but the deployed tokenizer artifact for canary nodes had token-v2026-02 due to an intermittent artifact publish race. I'll open an issue in infra and lock the packaging job.

amy: thanks. Immediate customer impact appears limited due to small canary % but still unacceptable. We'll keep the incident open for handoff and postmortem.

ops-bot: severity: Sev2 -> reduced to monitoring after rollback.

jordan: TODOs: 1) block auto-rollouts until pipeline fix (done), 2) add deploy-time validation that tokenizer hash in weights bundle matches deployed tokenizer on target hosts (tracking: ENG-issue-4721), 3) notify partners and CS (dave handling).

dave-cs: CS note drafted. Sending to customers impacted in the last hour with apology + timeline + mitigation steps.

amy: handoff to oncall for 2h watch. If errors reappear, page me. Postmortem owners: jordan (ML), kevin (SRE), amy (incident commander). I'll create postmortem doc and link to thread.

ml-deploy-bot: Deploy audit: rollback job jb-8243 completed at 2412345900. All canary instances confirmed healthy.

kevin: marking incident as mitigated, keeping channel open for follow-ups.

amy: thanks everyone. Follow-up sync in 1h for RCA and action items. :white_check_mark:
